{{Quote|Who are you and what's your business with the Rats?|[[Rancer]]|<ref name="The Heart">{{LivingForce|EndTimes: The Heart}}</ref>}}
The '''Tunnel Rats''' were a group of cutpurses and con artists who lived in the sewers in the floating city of [[Tolea Biqua]] on [[Genarius]]. They were lead by a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] called [[Cheese (individual)|Cheese]] and in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], they captured [[Rydna]], a member of the [[Believers]] in the tunnel. They disliked the Believers, so they began to torture him to try and exact any knowledge from him, but they were unable to do so. The [[Heroes of Cularin]], who were searching for a Believer stronghold, found them while they were doing this. They were able to find the location of this and the Tunnel Rats were willing to help them to co-ordinate an attack on it.
